branches.name: West Circumferential Scout Highway (Dhelv to Šurpu-Dhelv)

caverns.name: Dhelv Great Bottle Hall
caverns.notes: Zeijani capital (pop ~5,000): 280x200 m bottle hall under a 32 m throat well, 3 satellite farm pits, stepwell cistern, Kailasa temple, and deep catacombs.

caverns.name: Dhelv West Kipuka Portal
caverns.notes: Hidden cliff portal and caravanserai in old-growth kipuka forest; guarded by a rolling stone door 2 km inside.

caverns.name: Deep Ossuary & Guanche Vaults
caverns.notes: 60 m below Dhelv square: tiered loculi, mummy shelves, and mortuary chapel.

caverns.name: Šurpu-Dhelv (Ash-Spire Village)
caverns.notes: First of the 3 canonical Mungo-sized Zeijani cave/tuff villages: fairy-chimney tuff spires and 4-level underground galleries above a braided lava tube.

caverns.name: Zey'danin Kipuka Sally Portal
caverns.notes: Concealed lava-tube mouth 12 km NE of Zey'danin used by Zeijani scouts and poison-arrow raiding parties.

caverns.name: Qarnu-Tūbu (Horn-Well Village)
caverns.notes: Second canonical Zeijani cave/tuff village: Moray-style terraced collapse pits and a Chand Baori stepwell cistern trading with the southern Ash Nomads.

caverns.name: Nūru-Šaplu (Deep-Lantern Village)
caverns.notes: Third canonical Zeijani cave village: carved into a drained parasitic magma chamber with Raufarholshellir red/purple oxidised basalt walls; center of alecap brewing and fungal alchemy.

caverns.name: Station 11 Three Skylights & Hot Reach
caverns.notes: Station 11 lava tube: 3 roof skylights with siphon trees and glow mushrooms upstream; active molten lava channel and CO2 sump downstream.

caverns.name: Entombed First Monastery Lava-Tube Vaults
caverns.notes: LORE.md 6.15: The original monastery of the Monks of History, buried under welded ignimbrite when the Lesser Throne erupted.

caverns.name: Pluton Pressurized Lava-Tube Galleries
caverns.notes: Insulated titanium-basalt lava tube halls at 9,650 m (0.50 atm) housing Pluton's deep mining works.

caverns.name: The Tubes Cavern Settlement
caverns.notes: Canonical cavern settlement (sa8xk6pimb) in a braided rift-shoulder lava-tube complex.

caverns.name: Loj Twenny Cavern
caverns.notes: Canonical cavern settlement (spbzmhdqqd) on the western rift rim.

name: North-West Wall Pyroduct & Alph Headwater Conduit

branches.name: Catch SW Wall Sub-Fan Drainage Pyroduct

caverns.name: NW Wall Caldera Magma-Throat Vault
caverns.notes: Drained high-altitude (11,080 m, 0.42 atm) fumarolic throat cavern beneath the 12,180 m WSW summit rim.

caverns.name: Sacred River Alph Pressurized Subglacial Reservoir
caverns.notes: Subglacial meltwater cavern at ~6.3 km on Xanadu's NE ice wall where geothermal pressure drives the bursting chasm fountain at the head of the Sacred River Alph (biomes/xanadu/NOTES.md).

name: Erebus Subglacial Ice-Cave & Catch Oasis Feeder Tube

branches.name: Lasso ('The Last Water') Southern Pass Feeder Tube

caverns.name: Kverkfjoll / Erebus Blue-Ice Fumarole Vaults
caverns.notes: Geyser Station 5 (`--station ice`, biomes/geyser/PLAN-STATIONS.md): subglacial ice caves at ~7.26 km (0.64 atm, -20 C) lit blue from within, with 88 C boiling geysers and hollow fumarolic ice chimneys.

caverns.name: Bitta ('Bitter Water') Lava-Tube Spring Mouth
caverns.notes: Distal lava-tube spring surfacing at the fan toe of Oasis #4 (Bitta / al-Bitar, biomes/catch/PLAN.md), discharging mineralized volcanic brackish water.

caverns.name: Lasso ('The Last Water') Sub-Fan Cistern
caverns.notes: Southern lava-tube spring surfacing at Oasis #5 (Lasso / Lastu, biomes/catch/PLAN.md), the last water before the 7.3 km pass toward Strongbow.
